description: This file defines the 'DeviceIdentity' data class and the 'DeviceIdentityStore' class, which handles creation, storage, updating, signing, and verifying device identities using cryptographic keys. It manages device registration and authentication within the app context.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A data class representing the device identity, including device ID, public and private keys, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: A class responsible for managing device identity storage, creation, signing payloads, and verifying signatures.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads an existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists, updating device ID if key derivation indicates a mismatch.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key with Ed25519 signature scheme.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature against the payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the URL-safe base64-encoded version of the public key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from persistent storage.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads and decodes the device identity from a file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the device identity to persistent storage.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with a fresh key pair and computes device ID using SHA-256.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives device ID from the raw public key by hashing it with SHA-256.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes a SHA-256 hash of the input data and returns it as a hex string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into URL-safe base64 string without padding.

methods.name: base64UrlDecode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe base64 string into a byte array.
